thread:
Maria Nguyen: heads-up, vuln triage — CVE-2025-3102 (libssl -> TLS record parsing). Affects our inference runtime images that statically link openssl. Need plan for Dedicated + Private (VPC/on-prem) backports and KMS/RBAC implications.
Samir Patel: severity? exploitability? any PoC seen?
Maria Nguyen: NVD CVSS 7.5, limited PoC reported for specific stream parsing. We saw one internal repro on rtx32 image. Not widespread exploit in wild yet but high risk for exposed hosted endpoints. Customers with on-prem may be at different risk depending on image version.
Lee Chen: ok — root cause is a parsing bug in openssl <1.1.3p (example). For us, some images have bundled libssl (static) and others use distro pkg. So two backport tracks: rebuild images with patched openssl, and patch distro packages for images that rely on system libs.
Dana Ortiz: RBAC/KMS note: when we rebuild images for Dedicated/Private, we likely need to rotate a couple of keys and ensure service accounts have kms.decrypt on the new keys. For Private (customer-managed KMS) we must not assume access — must provide a migration doc for customers to grant permissions.
Julie Park: audit logging: we should emit an audit event when a patched image is deployed to a customer environment referencing the CVE and image digest. That helps compliance for SOC2 customers.
deploy-bot: Ticket created: SEC-2025-1142 "CVE-2025-3102 backport + KMS/RBAC runbook" assigned to @Maria, @Samir, @Lee. https://redwood.inc/issue/SEC-2025-1142
Maria Nguyen: proposed runbook (draft):
1) Identify affected images by scanning manifests and image digests.
2) For images bundling openssl: bump to patched openssl, rebuild, run unit + e2e.
3) For images using distro libssl: prepare package patch and test in minimal chroot.
4) Produce per-customer image tags for Dedicated/Private where customers need pinned binaries (format: redwood/dedicated:<base>-c<customerid>-20250315-patch).
5) For Private (air-gapped): create patch bundle with signed artifacts + apply script; provide checksums and GPG-signed release notes.
6) Coordinate KMS key rotation steps with customer: provide terraform snippet for granting kms.permissions to runtime SA.

Snippet for granting perms (example):
```
resource "google_kms_crypto_key_iam_binding" "runtime-decrypt" {
  crypto_key_id = "projects/PROJECT/locations/global/keyRings/R/ring/keys/k"
  role = "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
  members = ["serviceAccount:runtime-<customer>-sa@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

Lee Chen: for on-prem offline installs, add an executable script that replaces /opt/redwood/lib/libssl.so.* and restarts runtime. Example command for offline image update:
```
# on customer host
scp patch-bundle.tar.gz customer-admin@host:/tmp
ssh customer-admin@host 'sudo /usr/local/bin/apply-redwood-patch /tmp/patch-bundle.tar.gz'
```
Dana Ortiz: RBAC change needs careful review: we must not grant broad kms.* to runtime SA. Ensure only cryptoKeyDecrypter on the specific key version. Add audit annotation to the role grant with CVE ID.
Samir Patel: branching strategy proposal: create minimal branches per major release (e.g., release-2025.03) + per-customer overlay branches only if customer needs custom libs. Keep number of customer branches small; prefer signed image tags instead of long-lived branches.
Julie Park: audit event shape (proposal): { "event_type": "security.patch.deploy", "cve": "CVE-2025-3102", "image": "sha256:...", "customer_id": "cust-1234", "deployed_by": "redwood-ops", "timestamp": "2025-03-15T18:12:33Z" }
(we'll implement mapping to our audit-log pipeline)
Maria Nguyen: rollout plan: canary 1% (internal + opt-in customer) -> 10% -> full. For Private/on-prem, follow customer schedule; provide hotfix bundle for critical customers.
Ops Oncall: note — add monitoring alerts for TLS handshake errors post-rollout (rollback if >0.5% spike).
Samir Patel: timing: mark as security-critical. Aim for published patched images + runbook in 72h, customer bundles 5 days, mass rollout 2 weeks.
Dana Ortiz: action items:
- Maria: produce patch bundles + image tags (ETA 48h)
- Lee: offline apply script + test (ETA 48h)
- Samir: branch/CI changes and signed tags (ETA 36h)
- Julie: audit event schema + console annotation (ETA 48h)
- Ops Oncall: add rollback alert (ETA 24h)

Maria Nguyen: thanks — I'll update SEC-2025-1142 with the runbook steps and link to the image digests when builds complete. Please add any blockers in thread.
Samir Patel: adding note — check license compatibility for rebuilt openssl binaries for customers who require source attribution.
Julie Park: I'll draft the customer-facing email template for on-prem instructions and KMS grant checklist.
Maria Nguyen: closing loop: next sync in #sec-standup tomorrow 10:30am.
